description: Get latest breaking news from 70+ countries in 18+ languages. Returns full article text, author, source URL, and publication time. Filter by language, country, and category (technology, business, health, sports, science, finance, world).

language.description: ISO 639-1 language code (e.g. "en", "de", "fr", "ja", "zh"). Default: all languages

page_size.description: Number of articles to return, max 200 (default 10)

name: currents.news.latest

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.

title: Latest Global News
